candidate_rule: earliest generator manifest for same current ET calendar date; only original qualified first real two-sided NHL SOG provider offers; fixed original source candidate order independent of confidence, outcome or model advantage
source_required: Original untouched PropLine HTTPS body SHA + full native-player two-sided offer identity
Original pre-resolution quote row SHA and exact source-bound official player profile name
Original frozen Gamma model and immutable snapshot SHA, quote, player/event/line identity and source cutoffs
Collector C03 HMAC proof and raw original NHL official score and two team rosters
All model historical observations independently verified to original signed official player logs, profile, and official final source receipts
Actual live native receipt minted before event by at least three minutes
probability_definition: NB2 count likelihood with fixed shape=4 and mean=original plugin Poisson baseline; exact Over/Under/Push including integer push
primary_comparison: Paired proper categorical 3-way Brier and log loss versus exact plugin Poisson control for same original quote, line, player, event
secondary_comparison: Count CRPS versus same plugin Poisson control using official NHL SOG finals and DNP/void handling per independently verified book rules
aggregation: Equal weight per genuinely prospective local calendar date, paired then cluster by game/date; report opportunity denominators and abstentions
interim_policy: Do not declare superiority, tune shape, recalibrate, rank, or decide model promotion from interim observed outcomes
excluded_from_confirmatory_validation: All offers and events before this protocol was frozen and any run whose live source or timestamp integrity is unverified
source_semantics: HMAC authenticates collector possession, not independent publisher publication time
DNP_condition: Conditional-on-played SOG distribution only; no modeled DNP mass or confirmed NHL starter status
processing_budget: No paid compute, no NUTS; fixed-form count evaluation only
failure_mode: Explicit ABSTAIN with append-only attempt ledger; no backfill or reconstructed historical predictions
